channel.desc: Action 2016 Amidst the chaos of a civil war, two humanitarian workers face countless dangers and struggles, but find unexpected love and solace in each other, adding both comfort and complexity to their challenging lives. Charlize Theron, Javier Bardem, Brandon Phillips, Hopper Penn, Merritt Wever, Erin Dignam, Sean Penn.
